master_seed_selection: single a priori sequential Hour 7 namespace; not selected by trying outcomes
primary_general_outcome: mean successful placements per held-out challenge
mixed_rule: top-two margin below 0.35 retains low/mixed and mixed=true and uses primary diagnosis tutorial
target_skill_outcome: held-out post minus pre for diagnosed skill; higher is better
overall_target_standardization: divide by matching frozen Hour 5 calibration sample SD
primary_inference: paired mean difference, 95% t CI, paired t-test, two-sided p, Cohen dz, exact Wilcoxon signed-rank where appropriate
transfer: exploratory Pearson and Spearman association, unchanged from Hour 6
combined_analysis: only after independent Hour 7 reporting; exploratory inverse-variance fixed effect
